Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations

Class Migrator.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.Migrator.Builder
Enclosing class:
Migrator
public static final class Migrator.Builder extends Object
Collects what a Migrator needs and checks it before anything runs.

A builder is not thread-safe.

      public Migrator.Builder connection(String name, Schema schema)
      Adds a connection that migrations can name through Migration.connection().
      Parameters:
      name - the name migrations use, never null or blank
      schema - the schema builder of that connection, never null
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is blank or already added

    • listener

      public Migrator.Builder listener(MigrationListener listener)
      Adds a listener for migration events; call it again to add more.

      Listeners are called in the order they were added. See MigrationListener for what a listener that throws does.

      Parameters:
      listener - the listener, never null
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if listener is null

    • allowMissingOnRollback

      public Migrator.Builder allowMissingOnRollback()
      Lets rollback and reset go ahead when some records have no migration in this migrator, as Laravel does: the known migrations are undone and the unknown records are reported as MigrationResult.Outcome.NOT_FOUND and kept. By default such a call is refused.
      Returns:
      this builder

    • build

      public Migrator build()
      Checks everything and builds the migrator.

      Each migration's name is read once, here; Migration.name() must not change.

      Returns:
      the migrator, never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a migration name is invalid or used twice, a migration names a connection that was not added, or the table name is invalid
